A '''battle''' for the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Port Nowhere]]<ref name="CFANG" /> was fought in [[3630 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> between the [[Eternal Alliance]] and [[Crimson Fang]] gang members. In the battle, the Alliance's [[Alliance Commander|Commander]], along with the [[Eternal Alliance Recon Unit]], boarded the space station and freed it from the control of Crimson Fang under the legendary [[Elarea Aldraste]], killing her in the process.<ref name="CFANG" />
